notes: The 1985 Segmentation OBJECT-COMPUTER format is 'OBJECT-COMPUTER. [computer-name [MEMORY SIZE integer-1 {WORDS|CHARACTERS|MODULES}] [PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS alphabet-name-1] [SEGMENT-LIMIT IS segment-number] . ]' (§1985:XVI.2.2.2), each bracket once and in that order. objectComputerParagraph/objectComputerClause parse the three '85 clauses as modelled nodes; ClauseCardinality.ByClauseContext's Earlier (below 2002) figure fixes their Sequence and once-only count, read by ClosedFormatPass.ScreenClauseRepetition; VisitObjectComputerParagraph refuses clauses without computer-name at 85 (computer-name-optional-2002); VisitSegmentLimitClause/ScreenSegmentNumber screen 1-49 and VisitMemorySizeClause/VisitSegmentLimitClause remove both clauses from 2002 (COBOL0902). Probes (work-rr-04/o*.cob): legal forms (witness order with all three clauses; SEGMENT-LIMIT alone; MEMORY 8 WORDS without SIZE; MODULES; bare 'OBJECT-COMPUTER.' and 'OBJECT-COMPUTER. COMP1.') run, the REV-SEQ collating prints 'A AFTER B', a fixed overlayable segment 20 keeps its ALTER (OVL-A, OVL-B) and an independent 60 resets (IND-A, IND-A); b) SEGMENT-LIMIT before PROGRAM COLLATING or MEMORY COBOL2987, written twice COBOL2423, 50 COBOL6819, 0 and MEMORY SIZE 0 COBOL2386, 1.5 / empty / missing unit / FOO COBOL5506, no name COBOL0900, no closing period COBOL3408, an unknown clause COBOL1970; c) CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION, FOR ALPHANUMERIC and a second alphabet-name COBOL0900 at 85, and at --std 2002 MEMORY SIZE and SEGMENT-LIMIT COBOL0902. Classes a, d, e, f have no operand here. The witness runs the full three-clause form.

next.reason: 1985 Segmentation OBJECT-COMPUTER: 'OBJECT-COMPUTER. [computer-name [MEMORY SIZE integer-1 {WORDS|CHARACTERS|MODULES}] [PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS alphabet-name-1] [SEGMENT-LIMIT IS segment-number] . ]' (§1985:XVI.2.2.2). 2023 keeps computer-name-1, PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS alphabet-name-1 and the optional closing period (§2023:12.3.6.2; 'the second period in the General format may be omitted', §2023:12.3.6.3 SR4), adds CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION and FOR ALPHANUMERIC/NATIONAL, but has no MEMORY SIZE and no SEGMENT-LIMIT clause. A 1985 program that writes MEMORY SIZE or SEGMENT-LIMIT is refused under 2023 (stricter); a compile-time difference, no exception condition.
